errata.locus: the deposit route the call names
errata.was: The call names Zenodo as where this archive deposits, and anchors the journals in DOIs.
errata.now: The Zenodo account was terminated on 2026-06-19; 1,817 DOIs were tombstoned and 871 began returning 404. The mechanism stands. The archive's identifier is the AXN, the cluster anchors are AXNs and resolvable record URLs, and a DOI is not required to publish in these journals. Current instructions: https://www.alexanarch.org/how/ (deposit form: https://www.alexanarch.org/deposit/).
errata.reason: A reader following the call as published is sent to a closed route.

scope: reference, citation, source and count corrections; the deposited bytes and AXN are unchanged
